help.title: How can we help?

article_content.how_to_transcribe_audio: To transcribe audio, go to the Upload page, select your file, and click 'Transcribe'. EchoScript supports auto-detection of languages and background noise removal.
article_content.supported_file_formats: EchoScript supports MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, AAC, and OGG for audio, and MP4, MKV, and MOV for video.
article_content.managing_your_account: You can manage your profile, subscription, and security settings in the 'Account' section found in the top-right user menu.
article_content.upgrade_your_plan: Visit the 'Purchase' page to see available plans. Upgrading gives you more minutes, higher file size limits, and priority processing.
article_content.payment_methods: We accept all major credit cards and debit cards via Stripe's secure payment gateway.
article_content.refund_policy: Refunds are available within 7 days if you haven't used more than 10% of your allocated minutes. Contact support to initiate a request.
article_content.ai_summary_guide: After transcribing, use the 'Summarize' button to get a concise version of your transcript powered by advanced AI models.
article_content.speaker_identification: Enable 'Speaker Diarization' in settings to automatically label different speakers in your audio files.
article_content.exporting_transcripts: You can export your transcripts in various formats including TXT, PDF, and DOCX using the export panel below the transcription view.
